ache.title: “Your last chance” is a sales line, Nero
ache.note: Look at him: ‘Find out in this last-minute video! This is your last chance for those banners!’ That’s the countdown talking through Nero. He frames it as Yinlin or her weapon, Absolute Pulsation, as if those are the only choices. There’s a third: neither, and you still have your stuff tomorrow.
watch: character vs weapon: two ways to spend
a video timed to the banner’s end
ache.tip: When something says ‘last chance’, give yourself a day anyway. If it’s gone, you’ll still be fine.
lines: last chance for the banner, not for you
